paragraphs: A Jaguar AJ126 engine rebuild starts from £3,200, regardless of which of the four models it's fitted to - the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot.

A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required - submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Jaguar already has instead - strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most Jaguar owners choose, and it's the one we'd recommend for most situations.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting - sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call - particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries, especially given how many different AJ126 applications exist across the Jaguar range. Enter your reg below and we'll talk you through both options honestly.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild - a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle - restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the four AJ126-equipped models you drive. AJ126 Reconditioned, Refurbished & Remanufactured Engines Terminology Explained: Rebuilt: Existing engine stripped, inspected and rebuilt to original specification. Reconditioned: Broad industry term; we define our rebuild as a full strip and rebuild. Remanufactured: Usually implies a defined restoration process; our rebuild meets this standard. Used: Existing engine from another vehicle; we can source and fit these. What Jaguar Garage Means by "Rebuild": Full strip-down, inspection, measurement, machining where required, replacement of worn components, reassembly, testing, and refit - with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

faqLeft.q: What is the Jaguar AJ126 engine?
faqLeft.a: The AJ126 is Jaguar Land Rover's 3.0-litre supercharged V6 petrol engine, in production from 2013 to 2020. It's fitted across four different Jaguar models.

faqLeft.q: Which Jaguar models use the AJ126?
faqLeft.a: F-Type, XE, XF and XJ - see the full applications table above for exact variants and years.

faqLeft.q: Does the AJ126 differ between Jaguar models?
faqLeft.a: Yes. Ancillaries, mounting, ECU calibration, and supercharger tune vary by model and year, even though the base engine code is the same. We match by registration/VIN before confirming any rebuild or replacement.

faqLeft.q: Is an AJ126 from one Jaguar model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. An AJ126 from an F-Type isn't a direct match for one from an XJ - ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration all differ. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar AJ126 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on AJ126 rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: What are the common issues with the AJ126?
faqLeft.a: Timing chain stretch is documented on the AJ126 - the same pattern as the larger AJ133 V8, though less frequent and typically at higher mileage. Supercharger coupler wear and cooling system leaks are also known issues on higher-mileage examples.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an AJ126 from an F-Type?
faqRight.a: Yes. The AJ126 in the F-Type is one of the applications we work on regularly, across V6, V6 S and 400 Sport variants.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an AJ126 from an XE?
faqRight.a: Yes. The AJ126 in the XE is one of the applications we work on, across S and 300 Sport variants.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Jaguar AJ126 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Jaguar if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an AJ126 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most AJ126 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history - a particular concern given how many different AJ126 applications exist across the Jaguar range - and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
